reviewNotes: All three new sources and both unchanged imported helpers match the frozen inventory and executed copies. Original archived transfer receipt binds the same run/attempt/source/artifact, successful Mac producer matrix and complete outer ZIP SHA/bytes. Both fixed package SHA/bytes match the previously audited extraction record; no original package audit was rerun.

Source identity uses the original fixed Git registry and its Git blob/SHA verification to derive the exact ordered Mac producer job. Unique original artifact membership, successful producer/upload, upload time window, repository IDs, expiry, digest and exact constants remain required.

The complete original outer ZIP is streamed and hashed before extraction. Exact 12-member whitelist, no aliases/traversal/encryption/symlinks, bounded metadata/member/total bytes, all-member CRC, fixed Backroad source/version/game manifest and original checksums are validated. Only the two fixed original ZIP/DMG byte streams are extracted and independently SHA checked.

The existing Release ID/tag/source/repository/upload origin must match and remain draft/unpublished. Every current target asset is prechecked before any upload; duplicate names/IDs, incomplete state, wrong size/hash or wrong membership/direct response hard-fail. Identical assets may be reused only after original archive validation. No delete, overwrite, Release creation/edit or publication path exists.

Each absent target uses a single fixed-origin POST with the job token, bounded streaming, exact MIME/length, and a second streaming hash. Failures are not auto-retried. Partial success is preserved in the small receipt and a separate future invocation can reuse only byte-identical existing assets. Before/after each upload the draft/source are rechecked and returned assets are bound through the exact release asset list plus direct API.

Real draft asset API uses an untagged-20-hex temporary URL. The final helper allows only the exact repository prefix, fixed filename and fixed tag or this narrowly observed temporary form; list/direct ID/SHA/size and the target draft tag/source remain authoritative. No query, fragment, other host or arbitrary tag matches the full regular expression. Temporary draft URLs do not establish public delivery.

The workflow has no user-selected target/source parameters and serializes this one release. GH_TOKEN comes only from github.token with actions:read/contents:write; checkout credentials are not persisted. Imports use the already inspected original no-redirect downloader, which strips authorization before signed-blob redirects. Errors persist safe codes/types without raw signed URLs or tokens.

Only the bounded transfer.json receipt is uploaded and copied to a new immutable Git branch by the unchanged receipt exporter. Packages stay in the draft release. The workflow always retains a failure receipt when transfer has started.

Original 15 new offline tests and 22 unchanged transfer boundary pass logs were read, including actual draft URL, partial failure/resume, same-count symlink and single POST cases. Actionlint passed with shellcheck disabled as explicitly recorded; no test/native/API/upload was repeated by this reviewer.
limitations: This independent static review is not proof of a successful live upload or public release.
Existing source/package/signature/native gameplay audits remain separate and were not repeated.
Draft state is checked immediately around uploads; no operation in this helper publishes the release.
